Type: six-drawer wide dresser
Use: storing clothes; bedroom
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: oak wood with visible grain, matte finish, antiqued metal bar pulls
Colors: warm natural honey wood, dark bronze
Shape: long low case, two columns of three drawers, framed side panels, overhanging top, short square post legs, solid and substantial
Feel: warm, sturdy, homey
Goes with: cream walls, linen bedding, black or bronze accents; farmhouse or rustic bedrooms

Type: two-tone six-drawer dresser
Use: storing clothes; bedroom

Materials: walnut veneer drawer fronts, black painted frame, brass knobs and leg caps
Colors: black, warm medium walnut, brass
Shape: long rectangular case, black frame around six drawers with two knobs each, round tapered black legs with brass tips, raised and fairly light
Feel: sophisticated, bold, warm
Goes with: white or grey walls, brass accents, walnut wood; mid-century or modern bedrooms

Type: three-drawer textured chest

Colors: light natural wood, dark grey-brown, brass
Shape: boxy chest, three drawers with faceted pyramid relief, slim long pulls, splayed thin metal legs, raised and medium in size
Feel: textured, eclectic, warm
Goes with: white walls, brass, rattan and plants; boho or mid-century rooms

Type: compact three-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes; bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
